situations.title: 통증 척도 사정
situations.tagline: It hurts, but I don't really know how to put a number on it.
keyPhrases: On a scale of zero to ten, where is your pain right now?
Zero is none, and ten is the worst you can imagine.
It's okay to give me your best estimate.

situations.title: 진통제 투여 확인
situations.tagline: When can I get something for this pain? It's really bothering me.
keyPhrases: You had pain medicine about thirty minutes ago.
Let me check when you're due for the next dose.
I'll get you something as soon as it's safe.
goals: 마지막 진통제 투여와 다음 투여 시각을 확인한다

situations.title: 통증 부위 사정
situations.tagline: It doesn't hurt where they operated — it's more up in my shoulder.
keyPhrases: Can you point to exactly where it hurts?
Is that different from your surgery site?
Tell me if the pain moves anywhere else.
goals: 통증 부위와 수술 부위 일치 여부를 사정한다

situations.title: 비약물 완화
situations.tagline: Is there anything besides pills that could help me feel more comfortable?
keyPhrases: Let's try repositioning and some cold or warmth.
Slow, deep breaths can ease the discomfort.
I can adjust your pillows to support the area.

situations.title: 진통 효과 재평가
situations.tagline: The medicine helped a little, but the ache is starting to come back.
keyPhrases: How does your pain compare to before the medicine?
What number would you give it now?
Let's see if we need to adjust your plan.

situations.title: 통증 소통 안내
situations.tagline: I don't want to be a bother by asking for pain medicine too often.
keyPhrases: Please tell me whenever your pain changes.
You're never bothering us by asking.
Managing pain early helps you recover faster.

situations.title: 다중 진통 병용
situations.tagline: Why are you giving me Tylenol too? Won't the strong stuff be enough?
situations.brief: 다중 진통제 병용의 이유를 환자에게 설명하세요.
keyPhrases: We combine a few medicines that work in different ways.
This lets us use less of the strong opioids.
Together they control pain better with fewer side effects.

situations.title: PCA 사용 교육
situations.tagline: So I just press this button whenever it hurts? What if I press it too much?
keyPhrases: Press this button when you feel pain, and it gives a set dose.
It has safety limits, so you can't overdose yourself.
Only you should press it — not family.

situations.title: 마약성 진통 호흡 감시
situations.tagline: I feel so groggy and heavy after that shot... is that normal?
situations.brief: 마약성 진통제 투여 후 호흡과 진정 수준을 감시하세요.
keyPhrases: Some drowsiness is normal after opioid pain medicine.
Take a nice deep breath for me now and then.
I'll be checking your breathing closely.
goals: opioid 투여 후 호흡과 진정 수준을 감시한다

situations.title: 신경블록 잔여 효과
situations.tagline: My whole arm is still completely numb — will I ever get the feeling back?
keyPhrases: The numbness is from the nerve block and it's expected.
Feeling will slowly return over several hours.
Protect the arm since you can't feel it right now.

situations.title: 소아 통증 사정
situations.tagline: She keeps crying and won't tell me what's wrong — is she in pain?
situations.brief: 소아 환자의 통증을 사정하며 보호자와 소통하세요.
keyPhrases: We can use her face and behavior to gauge her pain.
Has she been guarding or crying more than usual?
Let's use a faces scale she can point to.

situations.title: 내성 환자 통증 관리
situations.tagline: I've been on pain meds for years, so the usual dose barely touches this.
situations.brief: 진통제 내성이 있는 환자의 통증을 관리하세요.
keyPhrases: Thank you for telling me about your usual medicines.
We'll factor in your tolerance when we dose you.
Let's set a realistic comfort goal together.

situations.title: 통증-불안 구분
situations.tagline: My heart's racing and I feel awful — I can't tell if it's the pain or just panic.
keyPhrases: Let's figure out if this is pain, worry, or both.
Where do you feel it, and what makes it worse?
Slow breaths with me — tell me what changes.
goals: 정서적 지지와 함께 원인에 맞게 대응한다

situations.title: 진통 부작용 감시
situations.tagline: The pain's better, but now I feel really nauseous and itchy.
keyPhrases: Nausea and itching can come from opioid pain medicine.
Tell me how strong the nausea is right now.
We have medicine to ease these side effects.

situations.title: 통증 조절 실패 재계획
situations.tagline: Nothing you've given me is working — the pain just won't let up.
situations.brief: 통증 조절에 실패한 환자의 계획을 재수립하세요.
keyPhrases: I hear you — your pain isn't controlled yet.
Let's reassess and talk to the team about a new plan.
We won't stop until you're more comfortable.

situations.title: 마약 과다 호흡 억제
situations.tagline: His respirations are down to six and he's barely rousable — I think it's the opioids.
situations.brief: 마약성 진통제 과다로 인한 호흡 억제에 대응하세요.
keyPhrases: His respiratory rate is six and he's hard to wake.
Let's stimulate him and support his breathing.
Get naloxone ready and call for help.

situations.title: 조절 불가 급성 통증
situations.tagline: The pain is a ten and it's getting worse no matter what you do — please help me.
situations.brief: 조절되지 않는 급성 통증을 사정하고 대응하세요.
keyPhrases: Your pain is severe and getting worse — I take that seriously.
Let me check for anything new like bleeding or swelling.
I'm calling the team to escalate your care right now.
goals: 합병증 가능성을 감별하고 팀에 긴급 보고한다

situations.title: 통증 뒤 출혈 징후
situations.tagline: The pain near my incision suddenly got much worse and it feels swollen and tight.
situations.brief: 통증 뒤 출혈 징후를 사정하고 대응하세요.
keyPhrases: Let me look at your incision and the swelling.
Sudden worsening pain and swelling can mean bleeding.
I'm checking your vitals and calling the surgeon now.
goals: 통증 악화와 부종에서 출혈 징후를 사정한다

situations.title: 구획증후군 통증
situations.tagline: The pain in my leg is way out of proportion, and my toes are starting to tingle.
situations.brief: 구획증후군을 의심하며 통증을 사정하고 긴급 대응하세요.
keyPhrases: Pain this severe and out of proportion concerns me.
Can you feel and move your toes, and is there tingling?
I'm calling the surgeon immediately — this can't wait.
goals: 불균형한 통증과 이상 감각으로 구획증후군을 의심한다

situations.title: naloxone 필요 판단
situations.tagline: His RR is five and sats are dropping — do we push naloxone now?
keyPhrases: His respiratory rate is five and sats are falling.
Let's give a small dose of naloxone and titrate.
Keep supporting his breathing while it takes effect.
goals: 호흡 억제에 대한 naloxone 적응증을 판단한다
소량 적정 투여와 호흡 지원을 협조한다

situations.title: 통증 급증 합병증 신호
situations.tagline: This is a totally different, sharper pain than before — something feels really wrong.
situations.brief: 급증한 통증에서 합병증 신호를 사정하고 대응하세요.
keyPhrases: A sudden, different kind of pain is important to check.
Let me look at your incision, breathing, and vitals.
I'm escalating this to the team right away.
goals: 통증 양상 변화에서 합병증 신호를 감별한다
